title: KR-87 ADF SYSTEM - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the steps involved in removing the ADF receiver from the airplane's instrument panel?
answer: ADF Receiver Removal . (1)  Remove electrical power from the airplane and turn the master switch to off. Disengage the ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel.
